enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Extend legs. Retract legs. Turn to back. Place arm under pillow. Breathe deeply. Remain sleeping.

Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over edge. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face with water. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread, butter, and milk. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out plate and knife. Pick up bread. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Open refrigerator. Take out jam. Spread butter on toast. Spread jam on toast. Eat toast. Drink milk. Finish. Pick up plate and knife. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet door. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close closet door. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Adjust collar. Comb hair. Pick up phone. Check phone screen. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Close door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Open door. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office. Open office door. Walk to desk.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Attend meeting. Greet colleagues. Sit in meeting. Take notes. Discuss project. Return to desk. Make phone calls. Write report. Type on keyboard. Print document. Pick up printout. File document. Talk to coworker. Drink water. Continue working.

Stand up. Walk to cafeteria. Stand in line. Order sandwich. Pay cashier. Pick up tray. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Talk with colleague. Finish eating. Pick up tray. Walk to trash. Throw away trash. Walk back to office. Sit at desk. Check phone.

Open computer. Check emails. Write proposal. Attend phone conference. Take notes. Edit document. Send email. Attend meeting. Discuss budget. Return to desk. Call partner organization. Update database. Print reports. Organize files. Talk to supervisor. Drink coffee. Continue working. Prepare for next day.

Save work. Shut down computer. Pick up bag. Walk out of office. Close door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk home. Open door. Walk inside.

Walk to kitchen. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out leftovers. Place on counter. Open microwave. Place food in microwave. Close microwave. Press start button. Microwave beeps. Open microwave. Take out food. Place on plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Place plate in sink. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Place dishes in sink. Turn on tap. Apply soap to sponge. Scrub dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in dish rack. Dry hands. Wipe counter with cloth. Sweep floor with broom. Empty dustpan into trash. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Press power button. TV turns on. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Turn off desk lamp. Lie in bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket. Remain still. Fall asleep.
